tools.name: reassign_domain_to_account
tools.description: Moves a domain into another account's folder, updates its stored record, and makes that account the new owner with admin rights.

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: ID of the account that will own the domain

tools.code:
import sqlite3

DB_PATH = "domains.db"


def _move_and_grant(conn, domain, new_owner_id):
    conn.execute("UPDATE domain_folders SET account_id = ? WHERE domain = ?", (new_owner_id, domain))
    conn.execute("DELETE FROM domain_acl WHERE domain = ?", (domain,))
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO domain_acl (domain, account_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'admin')", (domain, new_owner_id))


def reassign_domain_to_account(domain, new_owner_id):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE domains SET owner_id = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE name = ?",
        (new_owner_id, domain.lower()),
    )
    _move_and_grant(conn, domain.lower(), new_owner_id)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"domain": domain, "owner": new_owner_id}

tools.name: purchase_and_register_domain
tools.description: Registers a new domain through the registrar API, charging the customer's saved card for the registration, and emails a confirmation to the contact address.

params.name: years
params.description: Number of years to register for

params.name: contact_email
params.description: Email address to send the confirmation to

tools.code:
import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

REGISTRAR_API_URL = "https://api.registrar.example.com/v2/domains"
REGISTRAR_API_KEY = "changeme"


@tool
def purchase_and_register_domain(domain_name: str, years: int, customer_id: str, contact_email: str) -> str:
    price_lookup_response = requests.get(
        f"{REGISTRAR_API_URL}/price",
        params={"domain": domain_name, "years": years},
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {REGISTRAR_API_KEY}"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    price_lookup_response.raise_for_status()
    total_price_in_cents = int(price_lookup_response.json()["price_cents"])

    payment_intent_for_registration = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=total_price_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        description=f"Registration of {domain_name} for {years} years",
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
    )

    registration_response_from_registrar = requests.post(
        REGISTRAR_API_URL,
        json={"domain": domain_name, "years": years, "contact": contact_email},
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {REGISTRAR_API_KEY}"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    registration_response_from_registrar.raise_for_status()

    confirmation_email_message = EmailMessage()
    confirmation_email_message["Subject"] = f"Domain registered: {domain_name}"
    confirmation_email_message["From"] = "noreply@example.com"
    confirmation_email_message["To"] = contact_email
    confirmation_email_message.set_content(
        f"{domain_name} was registered for {years} year(s). Payment {payment_intent_for_registration.id}."
    )
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost") as smtp_connection:
        smtp_connection.send_message(confirmation_email_message)

    return f"Registered {domain_name}; payment {payment_intent_for_registration.id}"

tools.name: publish_dns_record
tools.description: Creates or updates a DNS record at the hosted DNS provider and saves the record in the local record table.

params.name: rtype
params.description: Record type such as A, CNAME, TXT

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("dns")
API = "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4"
TOKEN = "changeme"


@mcp.tool()
def publish_dns_record(zone_id: str, name: str, rtype: str, value: str, ttl: int = 300) -> dict:
    r = requests.put(
        f"{API}/zones/{zone_id}/dns_records/{name}",
        json={"type": rtype, "name": name, "content": value, "ttl": ttl},
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"},
        timeout=20,
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    db = sqlite3.connect("dns.db")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO records (zone_id, name, type, value, ttl) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (zone_id, name, rtype, value, ttl),
    )
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return r.json()
